name: Iven

skills.name: Magician
skills.description: You are able to cast the three basic spells; detect magic, operate portal and create bond up to four times per day. You may purchase additional spells and mana.

skills.name: Extra spell
skills.description: You may choose one additional spell from the spell list each time you purchase this skill.

skills.name: Spring lore (4 ranks)
skills.description: You can perform spring rituals and have two spring rituals mastered. Further purchases of this skill improve your mastery of spring magic.

skills.name: Night lore
skills.description: You can perform night rituals and have two night rituals mastered. Further purchases of this skill improve your mastery of night magic.

rituals.name: Blessing of New Spring
rituals.description: Increase wealth gained from a farm for three seasons and serves as a foundation for other farm rituals.

rituals.name: Blood and Salt
rituals.description: Grants five extra ranks to a fleet taking a raiding action.

rituals.name: Chirurgeon's Healing Touch
rituals.description: Target gains two stay with me uses each day for a season.

rituals.name: Merciless Wrath of the Reaver
rituals.description: Adds three ranks to a military unit that takes a raiding action during the next season.

rituals.name: Shroud of Mist and Shadow
rituals.description: Grants a concealing bonus to a military unit that takes a raiding action.

rituals.name: Verdant Bounty of the Twilight Bayou
rituals.description: Adds five measures to the production of a forest over the next season.

spells.name: Create Bond
spells.description: You may bond a willing target to a suitable item or group. Other than potions and herbs, most magical items can only be used if the user is bonded to the item. You may also break such a bond if the target or the item is present.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: Discern the level and realm of an enchantment that a single target close enough to touch is under. You can also use this spell to discern the level and realm of a ritual that is being cast if you are close enough to hear the words of the ritual. A referee is required to cast this spell.

spells.name: Heal
spells.description: This spell completely restores all lost hits. It does not affect a limb that has been affected by a CLEAVE or IMPALE call. If you swift-cast this spell it only restores three lost hits.

spells.name: Operate Portal
spells.description: You may open a portal to another location, or trace to where a portal was last opened to go to. Magicians can use portals to travel to the Hall of Worlds where they can treat with Eternals as well as using them to travel to other locations in the Empire.

bonded_items.description: Once per day, you may use the Unstoppable skill without needing to know it and without spending a hero point.

skills.name: Mighty strikedown
skills.description: If you have a hero point then you can expend it to call STRIKEDOWN when striking a single blow with any two-handed pole-arm that is between 60” and 84” long.

skills.name: Relentless
skills.description: You may restore a single limb that has been ruined by the cleave or impale call by expending a hero point and spending at least five seconds appropriate roleplay such as slamming your arm against a tree, shaking your head to clear it of pain, or loudly exclaiming that you feel no pain.

skills.name: Stay with me
skills.description: You may restore one hit to a bleeding companion and stop them bleeding to death by expending a hero point and performing at least five seconds of uninterrupted roleplaying.
